title: Ember Tea
description: At the start of the next [blue]5[/blue] combats, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: This relic has a counter that decreases by 1 each time a combat room is entered. When the counter reaches 0, the relic becomes disabled. The Strength is applied at the start of each combat room, not at the start of your turn within combat.
